title: LeadSource
description: A channel through which reachable prospects for a given Opportunity can be sourced. The Outreach agent uses LeadSource records to build per-cohort lead lists. Sample leads MUST be stored as hashes only; raw PII is never persisted in this record.

opportunity_id.description: ULID of the Opportunity this lead source serves.

access_method.description: How leads are retrieved from this channel. scrape_public must respect robots.txt and platform ToS; if violation, use api or paid_provider.

estimated_audience_size.description: Realistically reachable audience for this query, not the platform's total user count.

quality.description: 1 = noisy / cold; 5 = warm, well-qualified, high reply-rate expected.

cost_per_lead_usd.description: Fully-loaded cost per qualified lead in USD: tool subscription / leads-per-month + compute + any human enrichment time at operator's hourly rate.

compliance_notes.description: Per-channel compliance considerations: lawful basis under GDPR for EU prospects, prior-consent rules under Israeli Communications Law amendment 40 for IL prospects, CAN-SPAM for US, platform-specific ToS restrictions, suppression list reference.

discovered_at.description: ISO 8601 with timezone offset. IDT (+03:00) preferred for Israel-sourced channels.

provider.description: Name of the paid provider if access_method is paid_provider (e.g., Apollo, Clay, Hunter). Otherwise omit.

query_template.description: Parameterised search query used to pull leads from this channel. Use {placeholders} for variables. Must not include any private credentials.

sample_leads_redacted.description: Hashed samples ONLY — never raw PII. Used for dedup checks and audit. Each entry holds a SHA-256 of the lead's primary identifier (e.g., email lowercased + trimmed).

hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the lead's primary identifier.

hash_input_kind.description: What kind of identifier was hashed. Required to make dedup checks meaningful across sources.
